```{r paths_lists, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
############################################################
# project information
############################################################
## for biowulf (normally used)
parent_dir <- params$parent_dir

## this is where I put anything from nidap or biowulf to my computer from this run, also contains the annotated seurat obj rds, quicker to load from locally
input_dir <- params$input_dir

outputIMAGES_dir <- paste0(parent_dir,"/IMAGES")
outputTABLES_dir <- paste0(parent_dir,"/TABLES")
outputRData_dir <- paste0(parent_dir,"/RData")
outputEnrichr_dir <- paste0(parent_dir,"/TABLES/Enrichr")
output_dirs <- c(outputIMAGES_dir, outputTABLES_dir, outputRData_dir, outputEnrichr_dir)

for (curr_dir in output_dirs){
  if(!(file.exists(file.path(curr_dir)))){
    dir.create(file.path(curr_dir), showWarnings = TRUE)
  }
}
code_path <- params$code_path
functions_path <- params$functions_path

```

``` {bash run_scRNAseq_pipeline_hg38_PBMC3, eval = FALSE}
nano qcRun.swarm 
## one line per sample

bash setupQC.bash MF30_PBMC3_DAY8
bash setupQC.bash MF07_PBMC3_DAY8


## 7b. setupQC.bash
nano setupQC.bash
# be sure R 4.2 (done, no change)
# set R script to be scrna_QC.R (done, no change)
# set reference genome (hg38 HPCA)
# *** don't comment out init scRNA4, or activate scRNA4 & add
export TMPDIR=/lscratch/$SLURM_JOB_ID

module purge
module load R/4.2

if [[ ! -d /data/NCI_VB/$USER/R_libs/4.2 ]]; then
                  mkdir /data/NCI_VB/$USER/R_libs/4.2
fi
export R_LIBS_USER="/data/NCI_VB/$USER/R_libs/4.2"
```

```{r QC_separately, results='asis', fig.width=20, fig.height=7}
###### for each file in the input dir, can't read symlinks

files_to_use_prep <- list.files(path=file.path(input_dir))
files_to_use <- files_to_use_prep[grepl("_prefilter.rds",files_to_use_prep)]

#### generate dataframe withuseful metdata to get the order I want
files_to_use_df <- data.frame(file_name = c(files_to_use)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Animal = str_before_first(file_name,"_"),
                TissueBatch = str_before_last(str_after_first(file_name,"_"),"_"),
                Tissue = factor(ifelse(grepl("LN",TissueBatch),"LN","PBMC"),c("LN","PBMC")),
                Time = factor(
                  str_remove_all(str_replace_all(str_after_nth(file_name,"_",2),"POST","DAY2"),"_prefilter.rds"),
                c("PRE","DAY2","DAY8")),
                Method = factor(ifelse(grepl(paste(c("LN_","PBMC_"), collapse = '|'), file_name),
                                "method1",
                                ifelse(grepl(paste(c("LN3_","PBMC3_"), collapse = '|'), file_name),
                                       "method3","method2")),c("method1","method2","method3"))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Tissue,Time,Animal,Method)
  


######### prep data.frame to catch stats

  ## useful columns

                MiQC_clusters = ifelse(length(unique(so_prefilter$miQC.probability)) == 1,
```

```{r setMerge}
suffix_to_use <- "merged"
name_to_use <- "no batch correction"
reduction_to_use <- "pca"
default_assay_to_use <- "SCT"
```

```{r prepSO, eval = eval_save_so}
my_colors = dittoColors()


seuratObj_to_use <- readRDS(file.path(str_replace_all(input_dir,"filtered","integration"), paste0(str_after_nth(params$study_name,"_",2),"_",suffix_to_use,".rds")))

############# remake UMAP to 2D
npcs=50
seuratObj_to_use <- RunUMAP(object = seuratObj_to_use, reduction = reduction_to_use,
                                     dims = 1:npcs,n.components = 2,
                         n.neighbors = 30, min.dist = 0.25)


######## add useful metadata

### add in leveled sample & time & animal & tissue & batch
seuratObj_to_use$Animal <- factor(str_before_first(as.character(str_remove_all(seuratObj_to_use$Sample, "S_")),"_"),
                                       c("MB59","MC90","MC98",
                                         "MC73","MF07","MF30"))

seuratObj_to_use$Time <- factor(str_replace_all(str_after_last(seuratObj_to_use$Sample,"_"),"POST","DAY2"),
                                       c("PRE","DAY2","DAY8"))

seuratObj_to_use$TissueBatch <- str_before_first(str_after_first(as.character(str_remove_all(seuratObj_to_use$Sample, "S_")),"_"),"_")
                                      # c("LN3","PBMC2","PBMC3","PBMC3b")

seuratObj_to_use$Tissue <- NA
seuratObj_to_use$Tissue[which(grepl("LN",seuratObj_to_use$TissueBatch) == TRUE)] <- "LN"
seuratObj_to_use$Tissue[which(grepl("PBMC",seuratObj_to_use$TissueBatch) == TRUE)] <- "PBMC"


seuratObj_to_use$Tissue <- factor(seuratObj_to_use$Tissue, c("LN","PBMC"))





seuratObj_to_use$Animal_time <- factor(paste0(as.character(seuratObj_to_use$Animal),"_",as.character(seuratObj_to_use$Time)),
                                       c("MB59_PRE","MC90_PRE","MC98_PRE",
                                         "MC73_PRE","MF07_PRE","MF30_PRE",
                                         "MB59_DAY2","MC90_DAY2","MC98_DAY2",
                                         "MC73_DAY2","MF07_DAY2","MF30_DAY2",
                                         "MB59_DAY8","MC90_DAY8","MC98_DAY8",
                                         "MC73_DAY8","MF07_DAY8","MF30_DAY8"
                                         ))


seuratObj_to_use$Tissue_time <- factor(paste0(as.character(seuratObj_to_use$Tissue),"_",as.character(seuratObj_to_use$Time)),
                                       c(
                                         "LN_PRE","LN_DAY2","LN_DAY8",
                                         "PBMC_PRE","PBMC_DAY2","PBMC_DAY8"
                                       ))

#### ignores method

seuratObj_to_use$Animal_tissue_time <- factor(paste0(as.character(seuratObj_to_use$Animal),"_",as.character(seuratObj_to_use$Tissue),"_",as.character(seuratObj_to_use$Time)),
                                       c("MB59_LN_PRE","MC90_LN_PRE", ### combines method3+1 = 2 total samples for each
                                         "MC98_LN_PRE", ## only method1
                                         "MF30_LN_PRE", ## only method3
                                         
                                         "MB59_LN_DAY2", ## only method1
                                         "MC90_LN_DAY2","MC98_LN_DAY2", ### combines method3+1 = 2 total samples for each
                                         "MF30_LN_DAY2", ## only method3
                                         
                                         "MB59_LN_DAY8","MC90_LN_DAY8","MC98_LN_DAY8",#"MF30_LN_DAY8", ## only method3
                                         
                                         "MB59_PBMC_PRE",##2 replicate method3 samples combined + 1 method1 = 3 total samples
                                         "MC90_PBMC_PRE", ### combines method3+1 = 2 total samples
                                         "MC98_PBMC_PRE", ### only method1
                                         "MC73_PBMC_PRE","MF07_PBMC_PRE","MF30_PBMC_PRE",## only method2
                                         
                                         "MB59_PBMC_DAY2","MC90_PBMC_DAY2", ### combines method3+1 = 2 total samples for each
                                         "MC98_PBMC_DAY2", ## only method1
                                         "MC73_PBMC_DAY2", ## combines method3+2 = 2 total samples
                                         "MF07_PBMC_DAY2","MF30_PBMC_DAY2", ## only method2
                                         
                                    
                                         "MB59_PBMC_DAY8","MC90_PBMC_DAY8", ## only method 3
                                         "MC73_PBMC_DAY8","MF07_PBMC_DAY8","MF30_PBMC_DAY8" ## only method 3
                                         ))





### add factorized clean sample
seuratObj_to_use$sample <- str_after_first(seuratObj_to_use$Sample,"_") %>%
  str_replace_all("LN_","LN_method1_") %>%
  str_replace_all("LN3_","LN_method3_") %>%
  str_replace_all("PBMC_","PBMC_method1_") %>%
  str_replace_all("PBMC2_","PBMC_method2_") %>%
  str_replace_all("PBMC3b_","PBMC_method3_") %>% ### combine these 2 techreps
  str_replace_all("PBMC3_","PBMC_method3_") %>%
  str_replace_all("POST","DAY2")

seuratObj_to_use$sample <- factor(seuratObj_to_use$sample,
                                  c("MB59_LN_method1_PRE","MB59_LN_method3_PRE",
                                    "MC90_LN_method1_PRE","MC90_LN_method3_PRE",
                                    "MC98_LN_method1_PRE",
                                    "MF30_LN_method3_PRE",
                                    
                                    "MB59_LN_method1_DAY2",
                                    "MC90_LN_method1_DAY2","MC90_LN_method3_DAY2",
                                    "MC98_LN_method1_DAY2","MC98_LN_method3_DAY2",
                                    "MF30_LN_method3_DAY2",
                                    
                                    "MB59_LN_method3_DAY8",
                                    "MC90_LN_method3_DAY8",
                                    "MC98_LN_method3_DAY8",

                                    "MB59_PBMC_method1_PRE","MB59_PBMC_method3_PRE",##includes 2 reps 
                                    "MC90_PBMC_method1_PRE","MC90_PBMC_method3_PRE",
                                    "MC98_PBMC_method1_PRE",
                                    "MF07_PBMC_method2_PRE",
                                    "MF30_PBMC_method2_PRE",
                                    "MC73_PBMC_method2_PRE",
                                    
                                    "MB59_PBMC_method1_DAY2","MB59_PBMC_method3_DAY2",
                                    "MC90_PBMC_method1_DAY2","MC90_PBMC_method3_DAY2",
                                    "MC98_PBMC_method1_DAY2",
                                    "MF07_PBMC_method2_DAY2",
                                    "MF30_PBMC_method2_DAY2",
                                    "MC73_PBMC_method2_DAY2","MC73_PBMC_method3_DAY2",
                                    
                                    "MB59_PBMC_method3_DAY8",
                                    "MC90_PBMC_method3_DAY8",
                                    "MF07_PBMC_method3_DAY8",
                                    "MF30_PBMC_method3_DAY8",
                                    "MC73_PBMC_method3_DAY8"
                                    ))


seuratObj_to_use$Method <- factor(str_remove_all(str_before_first(str_after_nth(as.character(seuratObj_to_use$sample),"_",2),"_"),"b"),c("method1","method2","method3"))



######## add in sequencing round
seuratObj_to_use$round <- str_after_first(seuratObj_to_use$Sample,"_") %>%
  str_replace_all("LN_","round1_") %>%
  str_replace_all("PBMC_","round1_") %>%
  str_replace_all("PBMC2_","round2_") %>%
  str_replace_all("MF30_PBMC3_","MF30_round3_") %>%
  str_replace_all("MC73_PBMC3_","MC73_round3_") %>%
  str_replace_all("MF07_PBMC3_","MF07_round3_") %>%
  str_replace_all("MB59_PBMC3_PRE","MB59_round4_PRE") %>%
  str_replace_all("MB59_PBMC3_DAY8","MB59_round4_DAY8") %>%
  str_replace_all("MB59_PBMC3b_PRE","MB59_round5_PRE") %>%
  str_replace_all("MB59_PBMC3_POST","MB59_round5_POST") %>%
  str_replace_all("MC90_PBMC3_PRE","MC90_round4_PRE") %>%
  str_replace_all("MC90_PBMC3_DAY8","MC90_round4_DAY8") %>%
  str_replace_all("MC90_PBMC3_POST","MC90_round5_POST") %>%
  str_replace_all("MB59_LN3_PRE","MB59_round4_PRE") %>%
  str_replace_all("MB59_LN3_DAY8","MB59_round4_DAY8") %>%
  str_replace_all("MC90_LN3_PRE","MC90_round4_PRE") %>%
  str_replace_all("MC90_LN3_DAY8","MC90_round4_DAY8") %>%
  str_replace_all("MC90_LN3_POST","MC90_round5_POST") %>%
  str_replace_all("MC98_LN3_","MC98_round5_") %>%
  str_replace_all("MF30_LN3_","MF30_round5_") %>%
  str_after_first("_") %>%
  str_before_last("_")


seuratObj_to_use$round <- factor(seuratObj_to_use$round, c("round1","round2","round3","round4","round5"))
```

``` {r SubsetToClustersToKeep, include = FALSE, eval = evalSubclustering}
##### once this is run it doesn't need to be run with every rendering
## run in interactive session to keep track of any errors
### set default assay

### set max to 10G; https://satijalab.org/seurat/archive/v3.0/future_vignette.html
options(future.globals.maxSize = 100000 * 1024^2)

for(curr_group in names(clusters_to_keep)){
  curr_clust_to_keep <- clusters_to_keep[[curr_group]]
  curr_clust_noSpaces <- str_remove_all(curr_clust_to_keep," ")

### subset
Idents(seuratObj_full) <- full_res_to_use
seuratObj_to_use <- subset(x = seuratObj_full, idents = curr_clust_to_keep)

# colnames(seuratObj_to_use@meta.data) = gsub("^SCT_snn_res",paste0("Sub_",curr_clust_noSpaces,"only_SLM_SCT_snn_res"),colnames(seuratObj_to_use@meta.data))

# ### save 
# saveRDS(seuratObj_to_use,file.path(outputRData_dir,paste0(params$study_name,"_",curr_clust_noSpaces,"only_SCT.rds")))

#
######## include re-SCTransform
## re-run SCT https://github.com/satijalab/seurat/issues/4059; https://satijalab.org/seurat/articles/sctransform_v2_vignette.html
seuratObj_to_use <- SCTransform(object = seuratObj_to_use, vst.flavor = "v2", verbose = FALSE, return.only.var.genes = FALSE)

DefaultAssay(object = seuratObj_to_use) <- assay_to_use
#seuratObj_to_use <- FindVariableFeatures(object = seuratObj_to_use, nfeatures = 3000) #### for integrated there are only 3000 features, so some are removed when recalculate variable features

## Reproduce original behavior: rank ALL SCT-model genes by residual variance,
## take the top 3000, then keep only those present in the integrated assay (-> ~1949).
## Newer Seurat versions pick 3000 directly from the assay's 3000 features, which
## changes the PCA and clusters.
hv <- HVFInfo(seuratObj_to_use, assay = "integrated")

   stopifnot("residual_variance" %in% colnames(hv))

top3000 <- rownames(hv)[order(-hv$residual_variance)][1:3000]
VariableFeatures(seuratObj_to_use, assay = "integrated") <-
  intersect(top3000, rownames(seuratObj_to_use[["integrated"]]))
stopifnot(length(VariableFeatures(seuratObj_to_use, assay = "integrated")) > 0)
   cat(curr_group, ":", length(VariableFeatures(seuratObj_to_use, assay = "integrated")), "variable features\n", file = stderr())



seuratObj_to_use <- ScaleData(object = seuratObj_to_use)
seuratObj_to_use <- RunPCA(object = seuratObj_to_use, npcs = npcs, verbose = FALSE)
seuratObj_to_use <- FindNeighbors(seuratObj_to_use,dims = 1:npcs)

for (res in resolution){
  seuratObj_to_use <- FindClusters(seuratObj_to_use,verbose=F, resolution = res,algorithm = 3)#SLM
}
colnames(seuratObj_to_use@meta.data) = gsub("integrated_snn_res",paste0("Sub_",curr_group,"only_reSCT_SLM_int_snn_res"),colnames(seuratObj_to_use@meta.data))
colnames(seuratObj_to_use@meta.data) = gsub("^SCT_snn_res",paste0("Sub_",curr_group,"only_reSCT_SLM_SCT_snn_res"),colnames(seuratObj_to_use@meta.data))
seuratObj_to_use <- RunUMAP(object = seuratObj_to_use, reduction = "pca",
                                    dims = 1:npcs, n.components = 2,
                           n.neighbors = 30, min.dist = 0.3
                           )

#### save 
saveRDS(seuratObj_to_use_reSCT,file.path(outputRData_dir,paste0(params$study_name,"_SubclusteringBroad_RPCA_",curr_group,"only_reSCT.rds")))
```

``` {r setRes___subBcells}
dlog <- function(...) {
  txt <- paste0(format(Sys.time(), "%H:%M:%S"), " DIAG ", paste0(..., collapse = ""))
  cat(txt, "\n", file = stderr())
  cat(txt, "\n", file = diag_file, append = TRUE)
}
dlog("Seurat ", as.character(packageVersion("Seurat")), " | SeuratObject ", as.character(packageVersion("SeuratObject")))

dlog("Sub cols: ", paste(grep("Sub|rpca_Sub", colnames(seuratObj_to_use@meta.data), value = TRUE), collapse = ", "))

       " | n NA: ", sum(is.na(seuratObj_to_use@meta.data[[res_to_use]])))
  dlog("table: ", paste(names(table(seuratObj_to_use@meta.data[[res_to_use]], useNA = "ifany")),

}
```

``` {r boxplot_group1, fig.height=10, fig.width = 10, results = 'asis'}
### set levels
### for res that already have levels
if(grepl(paste(c("SLM_", "Clusters","clusters","BROAD"),collapse = '|'),res_to_use)){
  clust_levels <- levels(seuratObj_to_use[[res_to_use]][,res_to_use])
}else{
  clust_levels <- make.names(c(sort(unique(seuratObj_to_use[[res_to_use]][,res_to_use])),"NA"))
}



###### for each tissue separately

for(curr_tiss in levels(seuratObj_to_use$Tissue)){
  
    curr_so <- subset(x = seuratObj_to_use, subset = Tissue == curr_tiss)

  ##first, ignoring method
  cat("##### ",paste0(curr_tiss, " ignoring method {.tabset}"),"\n")
cat("\n")

  
 group_tab <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(curr_so[[c(res_to_use,"Animal_time")]], useNA = "ifany")) %>%
  rownames_to_column("cluster") %>%

  ### collect % of each celltype for each animal
  
  ### make longer 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = !cluster, names_to = "Animal_time", values_to = "NumCells") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Animal_time) %>%
  ### collect % of each sample (i.e Animal_time)
  group_by(Animal_time) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pct = round(100*NumCells/sum(NumCells),4)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ### collect FC within rep
  dplyr::mutate(Animal = str_before_first(Animal_time, "_"),
                Time = factor(str_after_last(Animal_time,"_"),c("PRE","DAY2","DAY8"))) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(cluster, Animal, Time) %>%
  group_by(cluster, Animal) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(FC = round(pct/pct[1L],4),
                log2FC = round(log2(FC),4)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ### rename FC to include the days
  dplyr::mutate(comparison = paste0(Time,"vsPRE"),
                cluster = factor(cluster, clust_levels)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Animal,-Time)


### select only  the pct for boxplot
group_tab2 <- group_tab %>%
  dplyr::select(cluster, Animal_time,pct) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Animal = str_before_first(Animal_time, "_"),
                Time = factor(str_after_last(Animal_time,"_"),c("PRE","DAY2","DAY8"))) 
 
       cat("###### ",paste0("plot"),"\n")
cat("\n")


 cat(" ",paste0("p by paired MW wilcoxon"),"\n")
  cat('\n')

v <- group_tab2 %>%
  ggboxplot(x = "Time", y = "pct",
            fill = "Time", palette = c("grey20","grey50","grey80"),
            facet.by = "cluster", scales = "free_y")+
  #geom_beeswarm()+
  stat_compare_means(aes(group = Time), 
                     comparisons = list(c("DAY2","PRE"),c("DAY8","PRE"),
                                        c("DAY8","DAY2")),
                     label = "p.format", method = "wilcox.test", paired = TRUE, 
                     #label.x = 1.25,
                     size = 2)+
  geom_point(aes(shape=Animal), size = 3, fill = "white", color = "black")+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 22, 24, 25, 23, 8))+
  geom_line(aes(group=Animal), color = "grey")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1))

plot(v)

cat("\n")
cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!


 
        cat("###### ",paste0("table Pct"),"\n")
cat("\n")

to_print <- group_tab2 %>%
   DT::datatable(extensions = 'Buttons',
            options = list(dom = 'Blfrtip',
                           buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print'),
                           iDisplayLength = 25,
                           lengthMenu = list(c(10,25,50,-1),
                                             c(10,25,50,"All"))))
            
            #) , height = "100%", width = "100%")
    print(htmltools::tagList(to_print))

 cat("\n")
  cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!




  
}
```

### TRIMMING PBMC/LN clusters {.tabset}

#### Prep tables {.tabset}

```{r trimSO_byComp_tables, results='asis'}

####### remove cells from clusters with:
## less than 20 cells per tissue
## more than 10 samples with < 3 cells/sample

#### first generate table with total number of cells per tissue



  
           cat("##### ",paste0("table Num Cells per tissue"),"\n")
cat("\n")

tiss_df <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(seuratObj_to_use[[c(res_to_use, "Tissue")]])) %>%
  rownames_to_column("cluster") %>%
  ### add helper column
  dplyr::mutate(helper = ifelse(LN < 20, 
                                ifelse(PBMC < 20,
                                       "tossPBMC_tossLN",
                                       "tossLN_only"),
                                ifelse(PBMC < 20,
                                       "tossPBMC_only",
                                       "keep"))) 
to_print <- tiss_df %>%
   DT::datatable(extensions = 'Buttons',
            options = list(dom = 'Blfrtip',
                           buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print'),
                           iDisplayLength = 25,
                           lengthMenu = list(c(10,25,50,-1),
                                             c(10,25,50,"All"))))

            #) , height = "100%", width = "100%")
    print(htmltools::tagList(to_print))

   cat("\n")
  cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!

  
  ####### now generate table with number of samples < 3 cells
  
  
  
           cat("##### ",paste0("table Num Samples at least 3 cells, per tissue"),"\n")
cat("\n")

samps3cells_df <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(seuratObj_to_use[[c(res_to_use, "sample")]])) %>%
  rownames_to_column("cluster") %>%
  ### make longer
  tidyr::pivot_longer(!cluster, names_to = "sample", values_to = "numCells") %>%
  ### add helper columns for LN and PBMC separately
  ## first add tissue
  dplyr::mutate(tissue = ifelse(grepl("LN",sample),
                                "LN",
                                ifelse(grepl("PBMC",sample),
                                       "PBMC",
                                       "none"))) %>%
  ### group by cluster & tissue
  group_by(cluster, tissue) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(numSamps_atleast3Cells = sum(numCells > 2)) %>%
  ### make wider
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "tissue", values_from = "numSamps_atleast3Cells")
  
  
                  
to_print <- samps3cells_df %>%
   DT::datatable(extensions = 'Buttons',
            options = list(dom = 'Blfrtip',
                           buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print'),
                           iDisplayLength = 25,
                           lengthMenu = list(c(10,25,50,-1),
                                             c(10,25,50,"All"))))

            #) , height = "100%", width = "100%")
    print(htmltools::tagList(to_print))

   cat("\n")
  cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
  
  
  
  ########### collect clusters to keep for each tissue
  LN_clust_to_keep <- c(samps3cells_df$cluster[which(samps3cells_df$LN >= 8)]) ### at least 8/15 samples with 3+ cells (includes at least 20 total cells)
  
  PBMC_clust_to_keep <- c(samps3cells_df$cluster[which(samps3cells_df$PBMC >= 11)]) ### at least 11/22 samples with 3+ cells
  

```

```{r addFINALNAMES, eval = evalAddFINALNAMES}
## sanity check: flag any clusters that didn't find a match in the Excel file

unmatched <- dplyr::setdiff(current_clusters, finalnames_df$original_name)

  warning("The following original names had no match in ccrvb47_FINALNAMESonly.xlsx: ",
          paste(unmatched, collapse = ", "))
}

## map old cluster labels to final names via left_join
seuratObj_to_use$respt4_rpca_ClustersWithSubs_FINALname <- 
  tibble::tibble(original_name = as.character(seuratObj_to_use$respt4_rpca_ClustersWithSubs)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(finalnames_df %>% dplyr::select(original_name, final_name),
                    by = "original_name") %>%
  dplyr::pull(final_name)

#### factorize using the excel-defined order (NOT reversed so order is correct for UMAPs)

  dplyr::pull(final_name) #%>%

  seuratObj_to_use$respt4_rpca_ClustersWithSubs_FINALname,
  levels = level_order
)
```
